Class Abilities

1st Level

Spell Use

  • Effect: Cast arcane spells per the Spells Per Day table, plus bonus slots from high Intelligence. You keep a spellbook: see Spellbooks in Spellcasting in Arneyan for your starting spells, the two you add each level and the cost of copying more.

Flexible Preparation

  • Effect: When you prepare spells, you may leave one place on your list open (two from 10th level); an open place counts towards your prepared total.
  • When you cast a spell, you may fill an open place with any spell in your spellbook of a level you can cast, as part of the casting.
  • The book must be on you, not in your hand.
  • The place then holds that spell until you next prepare.
  • A Ritual spell in your book can be cast as a ritual from an open place, which fills it. Always on.

School Focus

  • Effect: Choose one school of magic (see Spellcasting in Arneyan); the choice is permanent.
  • When you prepare spells, prepare one extra spell of that school from your spellbook, of any level you can cast; it does not count against your prepared total.
  • You gain one extra spell slot of that spell's level, which can only cast that spell.
  • If your school has no spell of the level you want, take one of the nearest level below that it does have.
  • 10th level (Second School): choose a second school, with a second extra spell and slot in the same way.

2nd Level

Arcane Recovery

  • Effect: Once per day, after 10 minutes of study, regain expended spell slots with a combined level up to half your Wizard level (rounded up). None may be above 5th level.

3rd Level

Potent Cantrips

  • Effect: A creature that saves against your damaging cantrip still takes half damage. Always on.

4th Level

Arcane Analysis (Intelligence)

  • Effect: After 5 rounds of study, an Intelligence check (Hard) tells you whether an item is magical, the school of its magic and its origin (Aldorethi craft, divine creation, alchemy and so on).
  • 9th level: on a success you also learn one of its properties, as the Identify spell.

5th Level

Arcane Ward

  • Effect: When you spend a spell slot to cast a spell, you gain temporary HP equal to twice the spell's level until the encounter ends (1 minute outside one). Keep the higher amount; it doesn't stack. Always on.
  • 8th level: three times the spell's level.

6th Level

Cantrip Expertise

  • Effect: Add your Intelligence modifier (minimum 0) to the damage of your damaging cantrips. Does not stack with the Cantrip Mastery feat.

9th Level

Arcane Resilience

  • Effect: You have Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects. Always on.

10th Level

School Mastery

  • Effect: Your first School Focus school gives you one benefit that is always on and one you may use once per encounter.
  • Abjuration: when Arcane Ward gives you temporary HP, one ally you choose within 30ft gains the same amount, under the same rules. Once per encounter, out of turn, when you or an ally within 30ft takes damage from a spell or a magical effect (a breath weapon, a gaze, a magic item's power; not a weapon's hit), that creature takes half.
  • Conjuration: a creature you summon with a Conjuration spell appears with temporary HP equal to your Wizard level. Once per encounter, as part of casting a Conjuration spell, teleport up to 30ft to a space you can see, or swap places with a creature you summoned within 60ft.
  • Divination: you have Advantage on initiative rolls.
  • Once per encounter, when a creature you can see within 60ft rolls a d20, you may have it roll again after you see the result; you choose which result stands.
  • You may do this on any turn, your own included; on another creature's turn it is your out-of-turn use for the round.
  • A roll made with Advantage or Disadvantage is rolled again the same way.
  • Enchantment: a creature that saves against your Enchantment spell doesn't know a spell was cast on it, unless it saw you cast. Once per encounter, every creature your Enchantment spell targets saves against it with Disadvantage.
  • Evocation: add your Intelligence modifier to one damage roll of each Evocation spell you cast with a spell slot. Once per encounter, one creature that saves against your Evocation spell takes the damage as if it had failed; the spell's other effects still follow the save.
  • Illusion: a creature makes its first save to see through each of your illusions with Disadvantage. Once per encounter, when you cast an Illusion spell, you are Invisible once the spell is resolved, until the end of your next turn; casting on that turn does not end it.
  • Necromancy: when a Necromancy spell you cast with a spell slot damages at least one creature, you regain HP equal to twice the spell's level, once for each casting.
    • Once per encounter, when your Necromancy spell drops a living creature to 0 HP or kills it, it rises at once as a zombie on your side, with HP equal to twice your Wizard level.
    • Its attacks use your spell DC in place of an attack roll: its target makes a Fortitude save or takes the zombie's damage.
    • Constructs, undead and creatures marked Solo don't rise.
    • It acts on your turn, obeys your spoken commands and falls when the encounter ends.
  • Transmutation: a Transmutation spell you cast on yourself or an ally lasts twice as long; an effect that follows when it ends waits until then. Once per encounter, as you cast a spell that deals acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder damage, change all of that damage to another of those types; the spell ignores Resistance to the new type.

Renown: Name

  • Effect: Your deeds are known. Title: Magister. Colleges and libraries of magic open their stacks to you without fee or sponsor. Your first follower, an apprentice, joins you.

13th Level

Scribe and Researcher

  • Effect: Copying spells into your spellbook, writing scrolls and researching a new spell all take half the time and half the cost, and a spell you research joins the Wizard list.

15th Level

Sculpt Spells

  • Effect: When you cast an area spell, you may leave out a number of creatures you can see equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum 1); they are unaffected. This applies to every area spell you cast.
  • Intelligence Bonus: permanent +1 Intelligence. It can take the score past 20, to 22 at most (see The Mortal Limit in Character Creation).
  • Renown: Holding: you may found a study (the first floor of a tower) as your Holding (see Your Holding (15th) in Keeps & Kingdoms).

17th Level

Ritual Adept

  • Effect: You can cast any Ritual spell in your spellbook as a ritual without preparing it or filling an open place.

20th Level

Spell Mastery

  • Effect: Choose one spell of 3rd level or lower in your spellbook; it may deal damage. It is always prepared and does not count against your total, and you can cast it without expending a spell slot, as often as you like. It carries your name.

Renown: Tower

  • Effect: You may found a tower or college (see Renown in The Arneyan Codex); each season 1d4 apprentices (1st-level Wizards) and a sage join it. While you hold it, you may copy one spell from its library into your spellbook each month at no cost.

Kits: Arneyan Arcane Traditions

Each kit is an item in the Kits compendium, in the Wizard folder. Drag one onto your character.

Wizard Kits represent the institution, tradition, or circumstance that trained the character in the arcane arts.

  • Each kit bends one of your features, as its Reshapes line says, and improves at 9th level.
  • The peoples, orders and places a kit names are examples, not the only ones: a kit suits anyone from a tradition like it.

Wizard Spells Per Day

  • Bonus Spells: Intelligence 13–15 grants an extra 1st-level slot, 16–17 an extra 2nd-level slot, 18+ an extra 3rd-level slot. Cumulative, and only acquired once the wizard is high enough level to cast that spell level at all.
